text: 100% Battery Life!!!. I wanted to do this review to help others who may be considering. I don’t usually do reviews but I received a phone that looks to be brand new! My battery life was at 100%! I was so shocked when I seen this because I was expecting atleast a phone with a 90 or lower percent. I almost didn’t buy because I always read one star reviews just to see if everyone has the same complaint but I’m so glad I looked past those and just bought it.
